LanguageData.RavenRelic_MastersBrush.label: (Raven) Master's Brush
LanguageData.RavenRelic_MastersBrush.description: A brush said to be left behind by the transcendent intelligence that created the evil axolotl, protected by a powerful psychic energy. It is recorded in the forbidden texts of the axolotls that it can only be used by someone acknowledged by that transcendent intelligence.
LanguageData.RavenRelic_MiliraPriceTag.label: (Raven) Price Tag Of A Certain Green Milira
LanguageData.RavenRelic_MiliraPriceTag.description: A price tag taken from a certain Milira's ear. No matter what method is used to scan the barcode on it, it will always prompt that the product does not exist. However, legend has it that with the blessing of a certain pink transcendent intelligence, the barcode can be successfully read.
LanguageData.RavenRelic_WolfeinPillow.label: (Raven) Wolf Sphere Body Pillow
LanguageData.RavenRelic_WolfeinPillow.description: A fluffy, perfectly round pillow that seems to parody the mascot Fenrir. According to unofficial Wolfein history, a resistance member named Wuwufensi who offended the megacorp elites was punished by being forced to push this wolf sphere pillow up a hill. Because the pillow is so round and cute, it would slip and roll back down every time it neared the top, forcing Wuwufensi to start over in an endless cycle. The pillow and the story behind it have sparked intense philosophical debates, but ultimately, it's just a very cute pillow, isn't it?
LanguageData.RavenRelic_MysteriousMilk.label: (Raven) Mysterious Dairy Drink
LanguageData.RavenRelic_MysteriousMilk.description: A milky white beverage with a mysterious aroma, said to come from certain races with dragon horns.
